description: Java class implementing an AMQP endpoint for managing device credentials within the Eclipse Hono project. It handles incoming messages, creates event bus requests, and provides responses according to the Credentials API.

classes.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: A class extending RequestResponseEndpoint to handle device credential messages over AMQP, implementing the Credentials API.

methods.name: CredentialsAmqpEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the endpoint with a Vertx instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the endpoint, defined as a constant.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Provides the address on the event bus for incoming credential requests.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage from an AMQP request message, handling JSON decoding and errors.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Verifies if the message passes formal verification using CredentialsMessageFilter.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Generates an AMQP reply message based on the EventBusMessage.
